{{Otheruses|Crystal Forest}}
The '''Crystal Forest''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Calipsa]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] period it was one of the only natural areas on the planet. It comprised five square kilometers of forest and projected several unusual plants and animals.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
